errorBody: We couldn't load this information. Try again.
emptyBody: Your tasks will appear here when you post one.
copyFailed: We couldn't copy the address. Select and copy it instead.
moreDescription: Choose what you'd like to do next.

approve.title: Approve the completed task?
approve.description: Approving says the work is done, and it can't be undone. If TasksNearMe holds your payment, it goes to your helper now. If something isn't right, go back and choose Report a problem.

decline_offer.title: Decline this offer?
decline_offer.description: The offer closes, and so does your conversation with this helper. You can't undo this. Your other offers stay open.

previewDescription: Actions come from the booking. Confirm a change, see why an action is unavailable, or try an outcome.

success.on_the_way: The client knows you're on your way.
success.arrived: Marked as arrived. When you're done, send the work for approval.

error.validation_failed: Check the details and try again.
error.payment_declined: Your card was declined. Try another card or payment method.
error.card_not_allowed: This card can't be used here. Contact support if you think that's wrong.
error.insufficient_funds: There aren't enough funds for this payment. Try another payment method.
error.requires_bank_verification: Your bank needs to verify this payment. Complete the bank verification to continue.
error.version_conflict: The details changed while you were viewing them. Refresh the page and check them before trying again.
error.not_allowed: This action isn't available to you. Contact support if you need help.
error.not_found: This item is no longer available. Return to your list and try again.
error.expired: The deadline has passed. Refresh the page to see your available actions.
error.rate_limited: There have been too many attempts. Wait a moment and try again.
error.limit_reached: You've reached a limit on your account for now. Check the help center for details.
error.offline: You're offline. Check your connection, then try again.
error.signed_out: You've been signed out. Sign in again to go on: anything you typed is kept.
error.unknown: We couldn't complete that action. Try again, or contact support if it keeps happening.
error.identity_required: We need to check your ID first. It takes about 2 minutes.
error.paused: New bookings and payments are paused for a little while. Nothing was booked or charged, so try again later. Bookings you already have go ahead as planned.
error.not_ready: This isn't ready yet. Try again in a few minutes.
error.unavailable: We couldn't reach a service we rely on just now, so nothing was done. Try again in a few minutes.
